decisions.reason: Product A is a close core extension in a growing industry, so it likely meets aspirations and is retained with low drop risk.
Product B remains close to the established condenser line, and with industry growth it continues to meet aspirations, warranting retention.
Product C, another close-to-core condenser, faces no reported shortfall and is carried by slack, so it is kept.
Product D builds on established repair capabilities but remains niche, and organizational slack allows the firm to carry its uncertain results.
Product E is a customizable product line close to the core, so its results likely compare favorably with aspirations and it is retained.
Product F is an incremental repair insert with niche demand; slack supports keeping it while results remain uncertain.
